mapper.select:
SELECT device_id, group_code, state_json::text AS state_json, version, observed_at, received_at FROM iot_reported_group WHERE (device_id, binding_generation) IN
(#{deviceId}, #{generation})
AND group_code = #{groupCode} ORDER BY device_id, group_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iot_reported_group ( device_id, binding_generation, group_code, order_scope, order_value, content_hash, state_json, observed_at, received_at, version) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{bindingGeneration}, #{groupCode}, #{orderScope}, #{orderValue}, #{contentHash}, CAST(#{stateJson} AS JSONB), #{observedAt}, #{receivedAt}, 1) ON CONFLICT (device_id, binding_generation, group_code) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM iot_reported_group WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND binding_generation = #{bindingGeneration}
